scripts.name: Spotify Controls (PKCE)
scripts.source:
import os
from pathlib import Path

control = os.environ.get('INPUT_BRIDGE_CONTROL')
action = {
    'R1C1': 'spotify_open',
    'R1C2': 'spotify_previous',
    'R1C3': 'spotify_play_pause',
    'R1C4': 'spotify_next',
    'R2C1': 'spotify_volume_down',
    'R2C2': 'spotify_volume_up',
    'R2C3': 'spotify_shuffle',
    'R2C4': 'spotify_repeat',
    'K2-CW': 'spotify_volume_up',
    'K2-CCW': 'spotify_volume_down',
}.get(control)
if action is None:
    raise RuntimeError(f'Unknown Spotify control: {control}')
if action == 'spotify_open':
    if os.name != 'nt':
        raise RuntimeError('Spotify launching requires Windows')
    os.startfile('spotify:')
    raise SystemExit

import spotipy
from spotipy.oauth2 import SpotifyPKCE

REDIRECT_URI = 'http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback'
SCOPE = 'user-modify-playback-state user-read-playback-state'
settings_dir = Path(os.environ.get('LOCALAPPDATA', Path.home())) / 'InputBridge'
secrets_dir = settings_dir / 'secrets'
client_id_path = secrets_dir / 'spotify-client-id.txt'
client_id = client_id_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() if client_id_path.exists() else ''
if not client_id:
    import tkinter as tk
    from tkinter import simpledialog
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.withdraw()
    client_id = simpledialog.askstring('Spotify setup', 'Spotify Client ID:', parent=root)
    root.destroy()
    if not client_id:
        raise RuntimeError('Spotify setup was cancelled')
    secrets_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    client_id_path.write_text(client_id.strip(), encoding='utf-8')

secrets_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cache_path = secrets_dir / 'spotify-pkce-cache'
sp = spotipy.Spotify(auth_manager=SpotifyPKCE(client_id=client_id, redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI, scope=SCOPE, cache_path=str(cache_path)))
playback = sp.current_playback()
if playback is None and action == 'spotify_play_pause':
    devices = sp.devices().get('devices', [])
    target = next((device for device in devices if device.get('is_active')), None)
    target = target or next(iter(devices), None)
    if target is None or not target.get('id'):
        raise RuntimeError('Spotify has no available playback device; open Spotify first')
    sp.start_playback(device_id=target['id'])
    raise SystemExit
if playback is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Spotify has no active playback device; press Play/Pause first')
if action == 'spotify_previous':
    sp.previous_track()
elif action == 'spotify_play_pause':
    (sp.pause_playback if playback.get('is_playing') else sp.start_playback)()
elif action == 'spotify_next':
    sp.next_track()
elif action in {'spotify_volume_down', 'spotify_volume_up'}:
    current = (playback.get('device') or {}).get('volume_percent')
    if not isinstance(current, int):
        raise RuntimeError('Spotify did not report the active volume')
    delta = 10 if action == 'spotify_volume_up' else -10
    sp.volume(max(0, min(100, current + delta)))
elif action == 'spotify_shuffle':
    sp.shuffle(not bool(playback.get('shuffle_state')))
elif action == 'spotify_repeat':
    states = ('off', 'context', 'track')
    current = playback.get('repeat_state', 'off')
    sp.repeat(states[(states.index(current) + 1) % len(states)])
